items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: There was Jerry Blake on clarinet... And you on alto.

ctx.x: Now, who was everybody? Was there O'Neil Spencer now on drums?

No. I'll tell you who was on drums. What's his name, Wallace Bishop was on drums. There was Billy Kyle on piano. There was Jerry Blake on clarinet. There was Kirby on bass. And a fellow we used to call 'Minnow,' Clarence Brewington, on trumpet. A nice group.

items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, sure. Alto player. He left I guess in the Thirties to go to Europe, and he never come back.

ctx.x: Yeah, sure. Alto player. He left I guess in the Thirties to go to Europe, and he never come back. The Thirties or early Forties. I think it was the Thirties.
But you were never in any bands with him.
